  '{{ String($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.pedido_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  false,

)

UPDATE pedidos
SET
  tipo_despacho = 'delivery',
  direccion = NULLIF($2, ''),
  lat = $3::numeric,
  lng = $4::numeric,
  postal_code = NULLIF($5, ''),
  costo_envio = $6::numeric,
  total = $7::numeric,
  tiempo_estimado = NULLIF($8, ''),
  sucursal_id = COALESCE($9::bigint, sucursal_id),
  distancia_km = $10::numeric,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::int AND restaurante_id = $11::int
RETURNING *,
  (SELECT datos_bancarios FROM restaurante WHERE id = pedidos.restaurante_id LIMIT 1) AS datos_bancarios
